DATE_RANGE.description: The GitHub Trending window: daily, weekly, or monthly. If unset or empty, daily is used.

LANGUAGE.description: An optional GitHub programming-language name or Trending URL slug, such as Python, C++, python, or c%2B%2B. If unset or empty, repositories in any programming language are included.

SPOKEN_LANGUAGE.description: An optional spoken-language name or GitHub language code, such as English or en. If unset or empty, repositories in any spoken language are included.
